rapport_notes: Warm greeting and friendly tone throughout; recovered well when handling the system-notes issue, but energy dipped at the end.
process_discipline_notes: No repeated differentiators; no silence discipline issues (though call ended without a formal close sequence).

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: None present — rep launches directly into logistics confirmation without trading the ask for a benefit or time-boxing the conversation.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moved straight into logistics: 'Looks like that's a house, is this a partial move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concern raised for the rep to dig into. Customer answered 'No' to the fragile/heavy question, so no follow-up was needed.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Covered indirectly via '...all rap pads, advance protect items when being moved' (Stage 2, bundled with rate breakdown, not explicitly 'careful with' framing but addresses protection).
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Covered: 'Three days before your move, you're going to get a meet your mover feature email and that introduces them to you helping ease attention of strangers arriving at your front door...'
evidence_quotes.communication_covered: Covered: 'the day before the move the branch will call you to confirm your move. And then the day of they will let you know when they're on their way.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not mentioned anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: '...it looks like we have an arrival time between 12:30 and 230 for about a four hour move.' Anchors to a range and personalizes it to the customer's move (30-min drive, one-bedroom partial, fourth-floor unit).
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: None of the five lines delivered. No commitment framing, no 'estimate is a window' explanation, no 'beats it pay less' 15-min language, no self-prep tip, no 'does that feel fair' check.
evidence_quotes.close: No rate-lock mention. No explicit ask ('would you like our help with your move?'). Call ends with 'If that changes my name is Bree you can reach out' and customer saying 'thank you so much' — polite but no confirm-the-booking language.

top_strength: Brianne recovered smoothly when learning the system didn't capture the customer's notes, turned it into a process opportunity, and delivered a clean logistics walkthrough with accurate personalizations (floor, elevator, parking proximity, 4-hour estimate).
coaching_note: Skip the quid-pro-quo framing and Their Agenda question entirely — both are critical discovery steps to earn trust and uncover unstated concerns before jumping to logistics; without them, you're guessing at what matters and missing the chance to position your differentiators against what the customer actually cares about, and you have no Save Your Ass framework to land once the estimate is quoted.
